title:
Your body.
A place to begin.
intro: Put a little clarity into what you feel. Select a part of your body to start your pain journal.
interaction: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
touchInteraction: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom
modelLabel: Interactive 3D body. Use the region selector for keyboard navigation.
loadError: The 3D view could not load. You can still choose a region from the list.
modelNote: A simplified body map for locating pain.
features: A moment to check in with yourself.
featureText: Find the spot, describe the feeling, and keep a dated record. Your recent entries stay together in your personal journal.
faqQuestion: Do I need an account to explore?
faqAnswer: No. Explore and select a body region freely. Sign in or create an account when you want to save an entry to your personal history.
medicalQuestion: Does the body map provide a diagnosis?
medicalAnswer: No. This is a journal for your observations, not a diagnostic tool or a substitute for a health professional.
footer: Make room for how you feel.
